title: P0224 – Throttle/Petal Position Sensor/Switch B Circuit High Input
description: Throttle/Petal Position Sensor/Switch B Circuit High Input
symptoms: Check engine light or stored DTC present

Clear codes only after repair and confirm monitors complete
